EC1: Evidence of low ovarian reserve by at least one of the following: AMH = 1,5 ng/mL and/or basal CD 3 FSH [OR] = 10 mIU/mL [OR] and/or basal CD 3 Estradiol = 60 ng/mL [OR] and/or previous egg collection yield = 3 oocytes.
EC2: Preexisting medical condition (thyroid disease [OR], diabetes mellitus [OR], hypertension [OR], pulmonary conditions [OR], cardiac condition…).
EC3: Severe male factor infertility (Total motile sperm count [OR] < 5 million/ml and/or normal WHO morphology <20%).
EC4: Hypersensitivity [AND] to Heparin or its derivatives.
EC6: Active hemorrhage [OR] or increased risk of bleeding [AND] due to impairment of homeostasis.
EC7: Severe impairment of liver [OR] or pancreatic function.
EC9: Injuries [OR] to or operations on the central nervous system [OR], eyes [OR] and ears within the last 2 months.
EC10: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC)  [AND] attributable to heparin-induced thrombocytopenia.
EC11: Acute bacterial endocarditis [OR] and endocarditis lenta.
EC12: Any organic lesion with high risk of bleeding (e.g.: active peptic ulcer [OR], hemorrhagic stroke [OR], cerebral aneurysm [OR] or cerebral neoplasms).
